title: Navisworks workflows and connector status
description: Explore Navisworks workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.
html:
SoftwareUpcoming

Autodesk

Navisworks

Navisworks brings multidisciplinary models together for coordination, clash review and construction simulation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Federate discipline models

Begin with the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended Navisworks preview, federate discipline models; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Review a clash set

Use the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended Navisworks preview, review a clash set; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Sequence a construction simulation

Start from the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended Navisworks preview, sequence a construction simulation; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
